info.title: TKeeper Hub API
info.description:
Public REST contract for TKeeper Hub. Use the Hub origin as the SDK base URL.
Send the existing SSO access JWT as Authorization: Bearer <token>. /auth/config is public.
Native commands preserve Keeper status and selected response headers. Saved commands can
return 202 with an OperationView; execution may fail after HTTP 200, so inspect operation state.
Idempotency-Key is mandatory for refresh, rotate, destroy, sign and compose. Do not automatically
retry mutations after an unknown transport outcome. Hub never exposes its execution mandate.
Hub dates are RFC 3339 UTC strings. Native JSON ceremony expiresAt uses Unix milliseconds;
X-EXPIRES-AT uses Unix seconds. Approval deadlines are never extended by reads or retries.
HTTP bodies are limited to 12 MiB; native Keeper command JSON is limited to 10 MiB.
Dynamic authority configuration and JSON Schema values remain open objects intentionally.
MCP is a separate protocol at /mcp; its tool catalogue is discovered through tools/list.

post.summary: Create key material
post.description: Hub fixes the DKG mode. CREATE runs directly. REFRESH/ROTATE use a saved mandate and Idempotency-Key. If approvals are required, response is 202; otherwise Keeper executes immediately. Omitting policy on REFRESH/ROTATE removes the previous policy.

post.summary: Execute a saved operation once as its owner
post.description: {} commits the collected receipts atomically. Only the owner can execute. A Keeper rejection returns an OperationView with state=FAILED; this HTTP 200 does not mean the native command succeeded. Execution is not automatically retried, including an unknown transport outcome.

post.summary: Cancel a pending saved operation as its owner
post.description: Cancellation changes the Hub workflow and does not revoke a copied native mandate before its TTL.

post.description: Reuses the saved request, generation and approval context. Preparation does not extend the original approval window.

get.description: Receipt counts do not imply cryptographic validity. Keeper validates final proofs only at execution. An unknown approvalExpiresAt remains null and must not be replaced by mandate expiry.

features.description: Sorted unique ids of loaded modules, including core and runtime dependencies.

authorities.description: Sorted unique authority types supported by the loaded modules.

sealProvider.description: Id of the configured seal provider.

nextCursor.description: Last returned key id, or null when there are no further matches.

authorities.description: Authority ids attached to the active generation.

description.description: Authority metadata description, when supplied by the artifact.

commandSchema.description: JSON Schema for the complete command object. Policy evaluation is separate.

ApproverRef.description:
id@sha256:lowercaseHex(SHA256(UTF8("TKEEPER_APPROVER_V1") || 0x00 || canonicalJson(descriptor))).
The descriptor is normalized first. JSON keys are sorted recursively. Id, metadata,
ref, and timestamps are excluded from the digest.

ApproverMetadata.description:
String pairs only. Keys use 1–64 UTF-8 bytes, values at most 512 UTF-8 bytes;
total key and value bytes must not exceed 16384. Metadata does not affect approval rights.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm supported by an installed approval verifier; names are case-insensitive.

publicKey64.description: Base64 public key in the selected provider's format. Keeper validates and normalizes it.

credentialId.description: Canonical unpadded Base64url credential id from verified attestation data.

publicKeyCose.description: Canonical unpadded Base64url public EC2/P-256 ES256 COSE key.

origins.description: Exact allowed origins in sorted order.

userHandle.description: Server-generated 32-byte user handle as unpadded Base64url.

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent metadata update.

nextCursor.description: Full last returned ref, or null when there are no further matches.

error.description: Extensible native Keeper error code. Persisted transport failures can also use this envelope.

message.description: Message on a persisted Hub transport failure.

ErrorType.description: Native Keeper error code. ErrorCode is extensible; clients must preserve unknown values rather than reject deserialization.

KeeperInitData.description:
Keeper init data. `threshold=1,total=1` selects mono mode.
`threshold>1,total>=threshold` selects threshold/MPC mode.

peerId.description: Local peer id. Must not exceed `total`. Mono mode requires `1`.

threshold.description: Required quorum size. Use `1` only with `total=1`.

total.description: Total peers in the quorum. Must be `1` for mono mode and cannot exceed 255.

KeyAlgorithm.description: Key algorithm exposed by an installed platform. Built-in values are SECP256K1, ED25519, P256, MLDSA44, MLDSA65, and MLDSA87.

QuorumPromotion.description: Target threshold/MPC quorum for mono promotion.

threshold.description: Target threshold. Must be greater than 1.

total.description: Target total peers. Must be at least `threshold`. The promoted keeper becomes peer 1.

QuorumPromotionResult.description: Result of mono to threshold promotion.

peerId.description: New peer id of the promoted keeper. It is always 1.

restartRequired.description: True when the promoted keeper must be restarted before normal operations.

ApproverReference.description:
Pins an immutable SIGNATURE or WEBAUTHN descriptor already registered on every current
member. Resolves only the complete ref; bare ids, latest and URLs are rejected. Duplicate
public keys are rejected after resolving references and inline entries together.

FourEyeControlMode.description: STRICT protects every supported operation. LENIENT protects ROTATE, REFRESH, and generation destruction.

WebAuthnCredential.description:
Pins a WebAuthn-only credential to a P256 approver public key. Omission means signature-only.
Credential id and user handle use canonical unpadded base64url. Public key uses the existing
P256 encoding and standard base64. Import these parameters from a trusted registration flow.
Every assertion requires user presence and user verification.

origins.description: Exact HTTPS origins without path, query, credentials, or fragment. Explicit HTTP localhost is allowed for development.

challenge.description: 32 random bytes in canonical unpadded base64url.

type.description: Extensible command type registered by the core or an enabled feature.
Material type registered by the core or an enabled feature.

Artifact.description: The command type selects the artifact format and its authority checks.

SignatureScheme.description: Signature scheme exposed by an installed platform. Built-in values are ECDSA, EdDSA, SCHNORR, BIP340, TAPROOT, and MLDSA.

TransactionArtifact.description:
For `tron.transaction`, `transaction` is unsigned transaction JSON.
For `xrp.transaction`, it is unsigned transaction hex.
For `solana.transaction`, it is an unsigned transaction encoded as Base64.

signingInput.description: Unsigned JWS protected header and payload.

imposters.description: Peers identified as bad during threshold protocols. Empty in mono mode.

SignedTransaction.description: EVM, TRON, or XRP composed transaction.

rawTransaction.description: Signed hex for EVM and XRP; signed JSON for TRON.
Signed or partially signed transaction encoded as Base64.

transactionHash.description: Available when the transaction is complete.

credential.description: Signed JWS with the referenced SD-JWT disclosures.

KeyStatus.description: Shows key current status, where UNKNOWN means key is tampered

actor.description: Original external actor when subject is an authenticated keeper peer

approverRef.description: Exact registered or updated credential version; does not indicate an approval vote.

metadataRevision.description: Resulting metadata revision for a successful registry write.

RegistryPolicyApprover.description: An Edict authority alias pins this exact registry version, including its approval method.

helperIds.description: Operator-selected canonical list of exactly `threshold` remote peer IDs.

algorithm.description: Algorithm selected from the helper consensus.

algorithms.description: Key algorithms registered by the platforms included in this build.

InitialApprovals.description: Optional caller-supplied approval context. proofs must be an empty array. Omit this object to let Hub assign keeperId, nonce and timestamp. Existing proofs cannot be supplied with a new command.

KeyAuthorityInput.description: Builtin authority ID, such as arbitrary, or a digest-pinned OCI reference. Keeper reads the authority ID from the artifact.

CreateKeyRequest.description: Key lifecycle parameters. Hub fixes mode to CREATE. Omitting policy on REFRESH/ROTATE removes the previous policy; Hub does not inherit it.

mode.description: Hub supplies this value when omitted and rejects another mode.

RefreshKeyRequest.description: Key lifecycle parameters. Hub fixes mode to REFRESH. Omitting policy on REFRESH/ROTATE removes the previous policy; Hub does not inherit it.

mode.description: Hub supplies this value when omitted and rejects another mode.

RotateKeyRequest.description: Key lifecycle parameters. Hub fixes mode to ROTATE. Omitting policy on REFRESH/ROTATE removes the previous policy; Hub does not inherit it.

mode.description: Hub supplies this value when omitted and rejects another mode.

SubmitSignatureRequest.description: Sign request. The command carries the signature scheme and hash.

generation.description: Generation to destroy. Current generation cannot be destroyed.

ImportKeyRequest.description:
Trusted dealer import request. Mono mode stores the imported key locally.
Threshold mode splits the imported key into peer shares.

value64.description: Base64 raw private key bytes. For Ed25519, use the standard seed bytes.

VerifySignatureRequest.description:
Pure cryptographic verification request. If generation is omitted, the active generation is used.
The command type selects material validation and serialization; no authority or policy is resolved.
Any supported material type, including typed or arbitrary material, may be verified independently
of the key's current authority manifest. A valid result proves cryptographic validity only.

EmulatePolicyRequest.description: Authority-policy evaluation request for the optional dry-run feature.

outcome.description: NOT_SENT means the transport did not send the command. UNKNOWN means execution may have occurred. Hub does not automatically retry.

ApiError.description: Hub errors use status/code/message; native Keeper errors use error/details. Native responses and selected headers are preserved. Infrastructure errors can have an empty body.

OperationView.description: Saved operation. Only its owner receives response, responseHeaders and errorMessage. Mandates and submitted proofs are never returned. A final execution error is represented by state=FAILED even when the execute HTTP request succeeds.

type.description: Operation kind, including dkg, sign, destroy and direct maintenance/registry commands.

request.description: Review context. Approval proofs are removed. Direct journal entries contain only safe summary fields. The shape depends on type.

response.description: Keeper result, or null when absent or hidden from a non-owner. Shape depends on the executed command.

type.description: Operation kind, including dkg, sign, destroy and direct maintenance/registry commands.

OperationExecuteRequest.description: Use {} to atomically execute the collected receipts. Legacy owner-supplied proofs are accepted only before any progressive receipt exists. Keeper verifies the final set once; failure is terminal. The saved business request cannot be replaced.

WebAuthnCreationOptions.description: WebAuthn JSON options. Binary values use unpadded base64url and must be decoded before navigator.credentials.create. timeout is milliseconds.

WebAuthnRequestOptions.description: WebAuthn JSON options; decode challenge and credential ids from base64url before navigator.credentials.get. timeout is milliseconds.

WebAuthnRegistrationCredential.description: PublicKeyCredential JSON. Binary response fields and rawId use unpadded base64url. Native Keeper validates ceremony context and rejects unsupported extension outputs.

WebAuthnAssertionCredential.description: PublicKeyCredential JSON. Binary response fields and rawId use unpadded base64url. Native Keeper validates ceremony context and rejects unsupported extension outputs.

WebAuthnApprovalRequest.description: credential JSON is limited to 262144 encoded bytes by Hub; it must match this operation, account and prepared challenge.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds; the earlier of approval and mandate deadlines.

SignatureSigningContext.description: Owner-only machine signing context. hashForSigning64 and approvalExpiresAt are omitted until known.

subject.description: Optional intended OIDC subject in the creator issuer; blank values and control characters are rejected.

token.description: Returned only by creation. Store and share as an invitation secret; list and inspection omit it.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Opening the invitation never renews it.

IdentityCatalogResult.description: Native identity response wrapped by Hub. isError is true for a native HTTP error or an error body, including one returned with HTTP 200. Hub failures outside the native call use ApiError.

AuthorityDescriptionResult.description: Native identity response wrapped by Hub. isError is true for a native HTTP error or an error body, including one returned with HTTP 200. Hub failures outside the native call use ApiError.

source.description: Edict authority source. The engine accepts at most 65536 characters.
Edict authority source. The engine accepts at most 65536 characters.

revision.description: Expected existing revision; 0 creates a draft. Stale revisions return 409.

defaultSource.description: Exact Edict literal for a default value.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required, nonblank owner-scoped key. Repeating the same action and business body replays the saved result. Reuse for a different request returns 409. A transport failure is not permission to submit another mutation.

PeerId.name: peerId
PeerId.description: ID from listKeeperPeers. Omit for the configured request peer. Only explicitly configured peer IDs are accepted; origins and arbitrary URLs are rejected.

PolicyCursor.name: cursor
PolicyCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor. Preserve it unchanged.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted ETag from the current approver record. Missing/stale preconditions are rejected by Keeper.

ExpiresAt.description: Native approval/registration deadline as Unix timestamp in seconds. JSON expiresAt on WebAuthn options uses milliseconds; Hub operation dates use RFC 3339. Retrying does not renew the deadline.

CacheControl.description: Authenticated API responses are not cacheable.

HubSession.description: Present with value required only when Hub bearer authentication requires sign-in. A forwarded Keeper 401 does not request a new Hub session.

ETag.description: Quoted approver metadata revision; pass it unchanged in If-Match.

RetryAfter.description: Retry delay supplied by Keeper. Do not automatically repeat a mutation with an unknown outcome.

Error.description: Request rejected, native Keeper error, or infrastructure failure. A proxy/server failure can have an empty body.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired Hub bearer token, or a native Keeper authentication rejection. Inspect X-Hub-Session before asking the user to sign in again.

PolicyInvalid.description: Authority document validation failed; errors identifies the failing stage.

BearerAuth.description: Existing SSO access token verified by Hub (signature, issuer, audience and expiry). Hub forwards this same request-scoped JWT to Keeper; there is no second client token or client-supplied mandate.
